name: Registration with invalid email is rejected [has space@x.com]
description: Registration: required fields, email and password rules, duplicate emails, and that the response never leaks the password.
descriptionHtml: Registration: required fields, email and password rules, duplicate emails, and that the response never leaks the password.
statusMessage:
XFAIL BUG: registration accepts syntactically invalid emails such as 'plainaddress' and returns 201 (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: invalid email 'has space@x.com' must be rejected, got 409 {"email":["A customer with this email address already exists."]}
assert 409 == 422
 +  where 409 = <Response [409]>.status_code
